item.text: The implementation now checks metadata before honoring `SkipUpdate`: mismatches force a download when updates are allowed and return a path-bearing error when updates are skipped. `newDBConnection` also opens the selected database, validates metadata and schema version, then closes it so its returned connection keeps the existing unopened lifecycle. I added mismatch cases to the existing table-driven test.

Implemented schema-version validation in [db.go](/app/detector/vuls2/db.go:31). Mismatches now force a download when updates are allowed and return a path-bearing error when `SkipUpdate` is enabled. `newDBConnection` also reports path-bearing errors for connection and metadata failures and rejects nil metadata or an incompatible schema.
